LESSON: ULUM AL-HADITH

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: General
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Ulum al-Hadith
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ulum al-Hadith, part of Hadith in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 General.

Key inquiry question: How was Hadith develop during the times of Prophet Mohammad S.A.W? 2. Why is it important for a Muslim to learn Ulum al- Hadith?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/from available reference materials on the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs and make a class presentation,

2. discuss the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs in groups and write notes,

3. brainstorm on the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith and share in class,

4. role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/from available reference materials on the factors that led to the growth and development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs and make a class presentation,
2. discuss the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs in groups and write notes,
3. brainstorm on the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith and share in class,
4. role-play the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith, learners with blindness can be given physical support as they role play. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ulum al-Hadith together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: listening and teamwork skills enhanced as learners discuss the development of

Hadith during the Prophet (S.A.W.) and Rightly Guided Caliphs’ time in groups.

• Self-efficacy: Effective communication skills enhanced as learners role-play the methods used by the Prophet

(S.A.W.) to teach Hadith.
